purpose: Rail-selection and finality recommendation across x402 (HTTP 402), Stripe USDC, card, ACH, and SWIFT. Per-transaction cost, eligibility scoring, micropayment support, cross-border flags. ~69k active agents / 165M+ x402 txns (2026).
